data.title: apps/invoicing: dead money-path guard, false plan rationale, and the invoices test-file line cap

data.to:
Three residuals from the AS-43 cycle-2 QA review (qa-priya, 2026-09-02; verdict PASS 20/20, none blocked the merge). AS-43 merged at fab239f. Bundled because all three are small and local to apps/invoicing.

1. DEAD GUARD ON THE MONEY PATH. lifecycle.js:222 checks Number.isSafeInteger(quantity * unitAmountMinor) before pushing a line item. It can never fire: AS-39 derives totalMinor as a SUM on every read, so the sqlite driver refuses an unsafe value earlier, at draft creation. Reviewer witnesses, all returning 500 'RangeError: create-draft' with 0 rows written, 0 Stripe calls and the transaction rolled back: quantity=9007199254740991 x unitAmountMinor=3; 1000000 x 10000000000; and two individually-safe items whose SUM passes 2^53. Predates the AS-43 rework cycle. Decide: delete the unreachable check (and say what now carries the guarantee, since the answer is the driver plus AS-39s SUM), or move the check somewhere it can actually fire — earlier, at draft creation, where the amount first enters the system. Do not leave a guard on a money path that has never been observed failing and cannot be.

2. PLAN TEXT: the ValidationError -> 400 rationale in AS-43 plan section 3.2 is false for the issuing routes. Those routes carry no request body; every repository input on them comes from Stripe, so a ValidationError there is not a client error. Three witnesses returned 400 ValidationError: finalize where the control case (a mapper TypeError) correctly returned 502. The IMPLEMENTATION matches the plan table exactly, so this is a plan-text correction for the tech lead, not a code change — unless the tech lead rules the taxonomy itself wrong, in which case the code follows the corrected table.

3. TEST FILE LINE CAP. test/invoices.test.js is 1,180 lines against the 1,200-line cap enforced in dependency-policy.test.js. Headroom is 20 lines by wc -l and 19 by the checker own split(newline) count — that one-line discrepancy is itself worth resolving so future readers do not disagree with the checker. The next task to touch this file trips the cap. Either split the file along a stated seam or raise the cap with a written reason; do not discover this mid-implementation of an unrelated task.

ALSO, for whoever plans this: AS-43 plan section 7 recipe F5 carries the same nonzero-baseline assert-applied trap already corrected for F4 and flagged for F8 — its stated baseline is 1 where the file real count is 2. Correcting it is tech-lead work on board state, not part of this task, but it belongs in the same pass.

ACCEPTANCE: items 1 and 3 each have a test or a checker run that fails without the change, shown red once per the house technique (assert the mutation applied, record the exact failing set, restore, prove restoration in a way that is not blind to untracked files). Item 2 is prose. Both suites stay green; no new dependencies; scratch only, no running container touched (asc-invoicing-web-1 on 8348, asc-chat-server-1 on 8347); no protected top-level file edited. Complexity low.
